components.role: shape normalizer: turns multi-dim elementwise computation into 1-D (collapse/expand-bounded) form so vectorization plans over flat last-axis domains
reshape-barrier remover: slides collapse toward outputs / expand toward producers immediately before flattening so the Flattener's collapse-group analysis is sound
vectorization engine: tiles, fuses and vectorizes flattened chains (plan-then-apply over transform dialect) and — with OutlineVectorFunction — establishes the VF granularity every later stage sees
VF-granularity control: re-merges outlined VF scopes at tensor level (L1, pre-bufferization) or memref level (L2, post) so bufferization/lowering plan over fewer, larger VFs
alignment-intent producer: post-bufferization, annotates UB memref operands of hivm ops with storage_align marks at hardware alignment units
alignment realizer: unions the marks' demands and re-allocates buffers padded behind strided logical views so later lowering sees aligned memory

context_nodes.role: materializes the VF callees immediately after AutoVectorizeV2 — the pair's output is what MergeVecScope consumes
context_nodes.note: context-only: not requested for deep explanation

context_nodes.role: the tensor→memref representation boundary (TensorCopyInsertion + OneShotBufferize) sitting between the two MergeVecScope placements
regbase-only pre-marking protection pass before MarkStrideAlign inside alignStoragePipeline
folds reshape-of-alloc between marking and enabling so fewer view ops separate a mark from its allocation
upstream analysis pass producing fusion groups on the Triton path; its callees feed the pre-vectorization world AutoVectorizeV2 plans in
the DISTINCT HIVM-level flatten pass (hivm-flatten-ops) after buffer sizing — same name as the requested HFusionFlattenOps but a different pass
context_nodes.note: kept visible to prevent conflating the two flatten passes

bridges.contract: tensor IR with reshapes propagated (collapse toward outputs, expand toward producers) and dynamic-dim barriers folded before the Flattener's dimension analysis
bridges.why_order_matters: FlattenOps Tidy declines via hasUnpropagateableCase when reshape noise remains — propagation first is what makes collapse-group analysis sound

bridges.contract: 1-D elementwise bodies bounded by collapse/expand pairs with unchanged external function signatures (tensor-level normalization; register-based indexing adjustments are the Tidy engine's own concern, see the flatten child dossier)
bridges.why_order_matters: on the Triton path flatten runs immediately before AutoVectorizeV2 inside hfusionAutoVectorizePipeline (:415-423 → :434-450, enableSIMDVFFusion ≡ enableTritonKernelCompile); on the non-Triton regbase path normalization happens earlier in buildHFusionRegBasePipeline — either way the vectorizer consumes post-flatten IR

bridges.contract: outlined functions carrying hivm.vector_function (+no_inline) — exactly the func set MergeVecScope collects (hivm::isVF) and merges
bridges.why_order_matters: without the outlined callees there is nothing for MergeVecScope to merge; the attribute is the entire discovery contract
bridges.representation_before: scalar linalg/hfusion ops inside the entry function
bridges.representation_after: vectorized hivm.vector_function callees with call sites

bridges.contract: a merged (smaller) VF call graph at tensor level, handed to TensorCopyInsertion/OneShotBufferize
bridges.why_order_matters: the L1 placement exists only when enableVfMergeLevel==1 and sits deliberately before bufferization so the memref world plans over fewer allocations/copies; mutually exclusive with L2

bridges.contract: concrete memref types and alias structure — the L2 placement (enableVfMergeLevel==2) merges VFs after bufferization where memory-side information exists
bridges.why_order_matters: L2 waits for bufferization deliberately: memory-side merge decisions need concrete memref alias info (child reasoning EV-022; ordering itself is source fact)

bridges.contract: annotation.mark {hivm.stride_align_dims, hivm.stride_align_value_in_byte} with byte value getHWAlignBytes(memory space) on ranked UB memref operands of hivm ops
bridges.why_order_matters: EnableStrideAlign errors on missing/mismatched marks and is a cheap no-op without them — the mark is its only input contract; FoldAllocReshape in between first removes reshape-of-alloc view chains

bridges.contract: the HIVM-level flatten (hivm-flatten-ops) runs post-bufferization after buffer sizing on memref IR — a distinct pass, not a repeat of hfusion-flatten-ops
bridges.why_order_matters: keeping the two flatten passes distinct prevents the classic misreading that one pass flattens both the tensor and the memref world

representation_boundaries.before: scalar elementwise ops in the entry function
representation_boundaries.after: outlined hivm.vector_function callees with call sites

representation_boundaries.where: one-shot-bufferize boundary between MergeVecScope L1 and L2

representation_boundaries.after: padded aligned alloc behind strided logical view (e.g. alignment = 64)
